We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. As a Senior GTM Strategy & Operations Manager at Vanta, you'll combine hands-on operational ownership with strategic problem solving to help shape the future of our Partner business. The GTM Strategy & Operations team partners with Sales and Channel leadership to design the processes, systems, governance, and insights that enable predictable, scalable revenue growth. We're building the operational infrastructure that helps our go-to-market teams move faster today while positioning the business to scale tomorrow. In this role, you'll start by owning key day-to-day Channel Operations to develop a deep understanding of the business. From there, you'll partner closely with Channel leadership and GTM Operations to identify opportunities, lead cross-functional initiatives, and build scalable solutions that improve the partner experience, simplify how we operate, and support Vanta's long-term growth. cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:cb.title: Underground Utility Foreman
cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:cb.description: Underground Utility General Foreman We are seeking an experienced Underground Utility General Foreman to lead underground wet‑utility crews and take full ownership of field production, coordination, and day‑to‑day execution. This role is for a true field leader—someone who understands underground utility construction, anticipates needs, organizes people and equipment effectively, and drives safe, high‑quality production from start to finish. Position Overview The General Foreman is responsible for delivering underground wet‑utility projects safely, correctly, and on schedule. This includes planning daily work, setting production goals, coordinating manpower and equipment, ensuring materials and inspections are ready when needed, and maintaining accountability across all field personnel. The ideal candidate thinks several steps ahead, identifies obstacles early, and keeps crews productive without compromising safety or workmanship. Key Responsibilities Lead underground wet‑utility projects from mobilization through completion. Establish daily/weekly production targets and ensure crews meet them. Coordinate plumbers/pipefitters, operators, laborers, subcontractors, and equipment. Plan work sequences, manage job pacing, and minimize downtime. Oversee installation of water mains, fire mains, sanitary sewer, storm sewer, hydrants, valves, vaults, and related systems. Enforce trench safety, competent‑person requirements, and OSHA standards. Ensure proper bedding, installation, restraint, backfill, compaction, and grade control. Review drawings and specifications; communicate field conditions and schedule impacts promptly. Maintain high workmanship standards while driving production and meeting schedule goals. Qualifications 10+ years of underground wet‑utility or heavy‑civil experience; strong field leadership preferred. Proven ability to manage crews, equipment, materials, inspections, and daily production. Strong knowledge of ductile iron, C900/C909, MJ fittings, restraints, valves, hydrants, bedding/backfill, and utility installation practices. Ability to read plans, understand elevations/grades, and plan work efficiently. Effective communication with field teams, inspectors, project managers, and general contractors. Experience with underground utility, site, water/sewer, or fire‑main contractors is highly desirable. What Success Looks Like A successful General Foreman knows the production target for the day, understands whether the crew is ahead or behind, anticipates tomorrow’s material needs, keeps equipment working, identifies issues before they become delays, and maintains safety and quality while increasing production. This role requires someone who owns the job in the field and delivers results—not just activity. Ideal Candidate You are a seasoned underground‑utility professional who has earned leadership through knowledge, preparation, consistency, and accountability. You think ahead, communicate clearly, solve problems proactively, and treat each project as if its success is personally yours to deliver.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:5e41e6ea-953c-.title: Snowflake Data Engineer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:5e41e6ea-953c-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Snowflake Data Engineer based in India. This is an opportunity for an experienced data engineer to help modernize enterprise data platforms through cloud-based data warehousing and migration initiatives. You will design and maintain scalable solutions using Snowflake while building reliable ETL/ELT pipelines across multiple source systems. A key focus of the role will be supporting Oracle-to-Snowflake migrations, from data assessment and transformation through validation and reconciliation. You will work closely with architects, analysts, application teams, and business stakeholders to translate data needs into robust technical solutions. The role combines hands-on engineering, performance optimization, data quality, and troubleshooting in a collaborative environment. You will also contribute to data governance, security, documentation, and the modernization of legacy data infrastructure. This is a remote, full-time opportunity for a technically strong professional who enjoys solving complex data challenges and improving enterprise data capabilities. Design, develop, and maintain scalable data warehouse solutions using Snowflake , ensuring performance, reliability, and maintainability. Build and optimize robust ETL/ELT pipelines for ingesting, transforming, and loading data from diverse source systems. Lead and execute Oracle-to-Snowflake migration activities, including data assessment, mapping, transformation, validation, and reconciliation. Analyze Oracle databases, stored procedures, existing ETL workflows, and data models to determine effective migration strategies. Design Snowflake schemas, tables, views, data models, and other structures aligned with business and analytical requirements. Develop complex SQL queries and transformations while optimizing workloads through appropriate warehouse sizing, query optimization, clustering, partitioning, and resource management. Ensure data pipelines deliver accurate, reliable, high-quality data to downstream analytics and reporting systems. Perform data validation and reconciliation between Oracle and Snowflake during migration and post-migration activities. Troubleshoot pipeline failures, performance issues, data inconsistencies, and other operational challenges. Collaborate with data architects, analysts, application teams, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver effective data solutions. Establish and follow best practices for data security, governance, documentation, monitoring, and operational reliability. Contribute to the modernization of legacy data platforms and the transition toward cloud-based data engineering practices. Requirements 5–8 years of professional experience in data engineering, data warehousing, or a closely related field. Strong hands-on expertise with Snowflake Data Warehousing and modern cloud data platforms. Proven experience developing and maintaining ETL/ELT processes and data pipelines . Demonstrated experience delivering Oracle-to-Snowflake migration projects , including assessment, transformation, validation, and reconciliation. Advanced SQL skills, including complex queries, joins, transformations, and performance optimization. Strong understanding of data warehousing principles, dimensional modeling, fact and dimension tables, and data integration patterns. Experience with data migration, reconciliation, validation, troubleshooting, and quality assurance. Good understanding of cloud-based data engineering architectures and modern development practices. Experience with tools such as Informatica, Talend, Matillion , or similar ETL platforms is a plus. Exposure to Python for data engineering, scripting, or automation is desirable. Familiarity with AWS, Azure, or GCP data services is advantageous. Knowledge of Snowflake capabilities such as Streams, Tasks, Snowpipe, Dynamic Tables, and Time Travel

matchgroup-matchgroup:lever:2695c869-f0d.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Enablement
matchgroup-matchgroup:lever:2695c869-f0d.description: Hinge is the dating app designed to be deleted In today's digital world, finding genuine relationships is tougher than ever. At Hinge, we’re on a mission to inspire intimate connection to create a less lonely world. We’re obsessed with understanding our users’ behaviors to help them find love, and our success is defined by one simple metric– setting up great dates. With millions of users across the globe, we’ve become the most trusted way to find a relationship, for all. About the Role Engineering Enablement helps engineering teams build faster, more safely, and with less friction. The team owns the tools, workflows, and platform capabilities that improve developer velocity, quality, and confidence across the product development lifecycle, with a growing focus on AI-native tooling. That includes Hinge's agent platform, the foundation for building and operating AI agents across the development lifecycle, alongside the CI/CD pipeline, developer-facing observability, and the tooling that makes spinning up services and internal tools frictionless. We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead Engineering Enablement within Platform. This role owns the team's strategy, roadmap, and execution while ensuring the work delivers meaningful value to engineering teams across the company. You will identify the highest-leverage opportunities to improve how engineers build, test, validate, and adopt platform capabilities, and you will lead the team that turns those opportunities into durable systems and practices. This is a hands-on platform leadership role with broad cross-functional reach. You will partner closely with product engineering teams and adjacent platform teams to ensure Engineering Enablement is building the right capabilities, driving adoption, and improving outcomes rather than just shipping tools.
responsibilities: Lead the Engineering Enablement team strategy: define the highest-leverage opportunities to improve developer velocity, quality, and engineering effectiveness.
Own the team's roadmap and execution: make priorities clear, drive decisions to closure, and ensure the team is delivering against meaningful outcomes.
Build and improve the tools, workflows, and platform capabilities that help engineers develop, test, validate, and ship software more effectively.
Treat internal platform work as a product: understand user needs, shape the right solutions, drive adoption, and measure success through velocity and quality improvements.

Advance the team's AI-native bets: make Hinge's codebase and systems operable by agents, and build the validation infrastructure that lets faster development translate into faster, safe product impact.
Raise the technical bar on the team through strong engineering judgment, clear standards, and credible involvement in architecture and design discussions.
Grow and manage the engineers on the team, including coaching, performance management, hiring, and development of future technical and people leaders.
Partner across Platform and with product engineering leaders to make shared work legible, coordinated, and effective.
Represent Engineering Enablement clearly to the broader engineering organization: what it owns, what it enables, and how teams should engage with it.

Summit Wash Holdings is a premier group of car wash brands growing throughout the Northeast, Midwest, and Southeast regions. At Summit Wash Holdings, all teammates produce speedy service in a fun and mutually respectful manner with gold-standard integrity, quality, and hospitality, all while maintaining a work-life balance. Our Mission is to provide a fast, quality car wash with friendly-spirited engagement and integrity. What do we want? We seek high-energy personalities that thrive in a fast-paced environment to provide a welcoming atmosphere for our Unlimited Wash Pass Members and a memorable first impression on our new car wash guests. A successful candidate would love working outdoors in all conditions and will be excited to roll up their sleeves to get the job done! You must be highly motivated and have an outgoing, friendly personality. All we ask is for you to share our passion for washing cars, creating memorable moments, and our obsession with exceptional guest service! In this role, you will review pre-seeded questions paired with images and provide accurate "golden" answers based on what you observe in the image.
